subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw expose `/stream` as a shared persisted session command and require channel plugins to opt into the new `previewStreamingSessionOverride` capability?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin public behavior and persistence contract, not a repair to an already-defined API; code review cannot safely choose its long-term ownership and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded shared contract
options.body: Keep the shared command and capability, document the external-plugin expectation, and require exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to an owner-specific implementation
options.body: Keep the feature out of the shared Plugin SDK until a concrete cross-plugin contract and rollout owner are agreed.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the proposal if session-scoped streaming policy should remain configuration-only for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared command and capability, document the external-plugin expectation, and require exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision determines a shared command, session-state, and Plugin SDK contract rather than a single extension implementation detail.
